messages:
olivia: quick heads-up — while doing a KB sweep i noticed several embed citations are inconsistent across /kb/embedding-guides. some pages use inline parens, others use a numbered footnote pattern. which style should we standardize on?

raj: thanks for flagging. my preference is to keep inline parenthetical citations for short refs (e.g., (Doe et al., 2023)) and reserve numbered footnotes for long-form references that include metadata. keeps the lines cleaner in prose. :+1:

olivia: that works. want to do the quick pass to normalize? i can open a tiny PR if we agree on a canonical snippet. also found 2 embed links that resolve 404 in that folder.

alex: can you paste an example of the canonical snippet you want? thinking MDX-friendly, e.g.:

```
This model uses prefix caching (Doe et al., 2023)[^1].

[^1]: Doe, A. (2023). Efficient KV caching. https://doi.org/10.xxxx/abcdef
```

suzanne: that looks fine. small note: our MDX renderer strips HTML footnotes unless they're plaintext; prefer the bracketed footnote style above. for inline citations, use plain parentheses and include a short link in parentheses if needed: `(Doe et al., 2023, https://doi.org/10.xxxx/abcdef)` so external readers get the url w/out expanding footnotes.

olivia: perfect — i'll: 1) run a grep over /kb/emb* to find patterns, 2) replace long-form footnotes with inline parentheticals for short refs, and 3) create a tiny PR that updates the handful of pages and fixes the 404 embeds.

docs-bot: link-scan report — found 2 broken embed URLs in /kb/embedding-guides: 1) https://oldhost.example/asset/kv-cache.png (404) 2) https://doi.org/10.xxxx/expired (redirect loop).

raj: thanks bot. olivia — if you want, ping @suzanne for a quick CR. i'll approve once small linter warnings are fixed.

olivia: will do. target PR in the next 2 hours — pinging @suzanne for CR when ready. short description: "normalize citation style in embedding guides + fix 404 embeds". any objections?

alex: no objections from me. can we also add a one-line note in the docs styleguide (docs/style/citations.md) so future authors follow the pattern?

suzanne: good call — add that to the PR and i'll take the CR. :rocket:

olivia: sweet — thanks all, will post PR link when up.
